name: BowlersMart pro shops
type: pro shop chain with online store
location_or_platform: Michigan (Roseville, Sterling Heights) and Illinois markets; also sells online
why_a_fit: The largest pro-shop chain with evidence in our searches: a company announcement describes a 21st location opening and a 22nd expected, and calls it a pro shop chain. Every location fits and drills from a drill sheet, so a counter that can enter a customer's sheet is already part of the job.
audience_size_or_notes: Location count comes from an undated announcement, so the current count is unverified. Two Michigan shops were listed in directories (Roseville inside a bowling center, and Bowling IQ by BowlersMart in Sterling Heights). Company describes itself as an online pro shop retailer as well, so one conversation covers counter and web. Wave 3 for the chain; Wave 1 for a single-location test call.
contact_path: Corporate contact page on the company site; ask for whoever buys new products and training aids. In parallel, call one location's manager and offer a sizer plate demo.

name: Virtue Bowling Supply
type: multi-store pro shop company with franchise
why_a_fit: A multi-store pro shop company founded in 2013 that now franchises. Its customers already pay for fit replication: the shop sells a silicone thumb mold at $15 for the master and $20 per copy, and the drilling service duplicates a fit from an existing ball.
audience_size_or_notes: Store count not found; the About page says one co-founder works as an area manager over several stores. A second result lists an IBPSIA Master Technician certification on a Virtue team bio page. The shop sells a 2027 Las Vegas Open Championships package, which suggests it attends that event. Wave 2.
contact_path: Contact page on the company site; ask for the area manager. The Alhambra franchise owners are named on the location page and can be reached through that page.

name: Lucky Strike Entertainment center pro shops (formerly Bowlero)
type: bowling center operator with on-site pro shops
location_or_platform: United States, 300+ centers; pro shops are on-site at some locations
why_a_fit: The largest center operator found. Acquisition releases list on-site pro shops at several centers, and a local report says its Sayville location has a pro shop. A company-level yes would put the sizer plate and counter card in many centers at once. The company has owned the PBA since 2019.
audience_size_or_notes: Not every center has a pro shop, and no source says which ones drill. Business plan table M19 gives 370 locations (Aug 2025); that figure was not re-read in this search pass. Long shot, so start with one center pro shop in person. Wave 4.
contact_path: Corporate vendor or partnership inquiry path on the company website. Start instead with the pro shop manager at one nearby center and ask who handles supplier decisions.

name: BowlerX
type: online pro shop with a physical shop and coaching
location_or_platform: Bethlehem, Pennsylvania (pro shop at Town & Country Lanes); ships nationwide
why_a_fit: Its drilling page says it accepts a drill sheet by upload or email and can copy the measurements of a ball you mail in, so a FitSlice customer's sheet already travels through this shop. It also sells training aids, offers coaching with USBC Silver-level coaches, and has a creator on its team who reviews products.
audience_size_or_notes: Founded by a PBA member; family operated since 2007 per its own pages. Its policy says drilled balls are not returnable except for manufacturer defects, which is relevant to how we explain our fit guarantee. One pitch can cover drilling intake and the retail catalogue (see 04). If the creator on its team is also approached, both sides must know about each other and each mention needs its own disclosure. Wave 2.
contact_path: Contact page on the company site; ask for the owner or the buyer. Mention the drill-sheet upload page as the reason for the call.

name: Bowlerstore.com
type: online pro shop with mail-in drilling
location_or_platform: Versailles, Ohio (showroom with two lanes); ships nationwide
why_a_fit: Mail-in drilling since 1995 with a prepaid label, and staff keep customers' specs on file for future orders. That is a ready-made drill-sheet database. The company also title-sponsors a PBA regional event in Coldwater, Ohio each August, which links this target to the events list.
audience_size_or_notes: Staff describe 20+ years of pro shop, drilling and internet retail experience. Sells through a major marketplace as a third-party seller as well. Wave 2.
contact_path: Contact form or live-chat page on the company site; ask for the buyer and for the person who runs drilling.

name: The Pro Shop @ Coal Creek (Jack Jackson)
type: IBPSIA Master Certified Technician and USBC coach
why_a_fit: A coach-technician who fits, lays out and drills and also coaches, so he sees how fit and release interact. The USBC coaching profile lists the IBPSIA Master Certified Technician credential.
audience_size_or_notes: Credential is self-reported on a coach profile. A search for the shop itself returned no dedicated page, so confirm the shop name and hours by phone before sending anything. Good candidate for a seeded unit under the coach tier (05 Section 1.2, tier C). Wave 1.
contact_path: Call the Coal Creek bowling center front desk and ask for the pro shop; the coach profile lists how to reach him.

name: May City Bowl pro shop
why_a_fit: Describes itself as the only IBPSIA certified pro shop in Iowa. A certified technician is the person we want entering a customer's sheet at the counter.
audience_size_or_notes: Listed as a facility for a university bowling program, so a coach and college bowlers may be nearby. Self-reported certification. Wave 1.
contact_path: Call the shop and ask for the technician on duty; offer to mail a sizer plate and counter card.

name: Pro Connection at Desert Strike Lanes
type: IBPSIA-certified shop on a military base
why_a_fit: Lists IBPSIA certified technicians and USBC Silver and Bronze coaches on staff in one shop, which covers both fitting and coaching conversations.
audience_size_or_notes: Run through the base recreation program, so business terms may differ from a private shop. Check the base program's rules on outside vendors first. Wave 2.
contact_path: Pro Connection page on the base recreation site; contact the bowling center manager and ask for the pro shop lead.

name: Sandy Hill Lanes pro shop
type: IBPSIA-certified shop on a military base
why_a_fit: Its pro shop staff are listed as certified by IBPSIA. A second certified shop in a different region gives the pro-shop pilot geographic spread.
audience_size_or_notes: Run through a base recreation program, so check outside-vendor rules first. Wave 2.
contact_path: Bowling page on the base recreation site; contact the center manager and ask for the pro shop lead.

name: Alley Cats Entertainment pro shop
why_a_fit: The shop states that staff are IBPSIA trained and certified. A small-town shop is a good test of whether a counter will enter a sheet without a big company behind it.
audience_size_or_notes: Self-reported on the shop page. Wave 1.
contact_path: Pro shop page on the center site; call and ask for the pro shop operator.

name: The Martell Method (pro shop and coaching)
location_or_platform: Coram, New York (inside Coram Country Lanes)
why_a_fit: Run by a PBA tour member and 2024 PBA East Regional champion who offers custom drilling, fittings and lessons under one name. A competitive bowler who coaches is a likely early seeded unit and a peer voice among Long Island shops.
audience_size_or_notes: Opening date comes from a 2025 local article. The operator previously ran a shop in West Babylon. Any public quote waits until he has said something; use [QUOTE PLACEHOLDER — Michael Martell] until then. Wave 1.
contact_path: Message through the Coram Country Lanes page or the center's social page and ask for The Martell Method.

name: Revolutions Bowling Services
location_or_platform: Mokena, Illinois area (per a lessons marketplace profile)
why_a_fit: Describes 26 years running bowling pro shops and membership in IBPSIA. Long experience means many drill sheets seen and a view on which customers would use a trainer.
audience_size_or_notes: Only source is a self-description on a lessons marketplace, and the location in the listing differs from the search term. Verify before outreach. Wave 2.
contact_path: Contact route on the lessons marketplace profile; confirm the shop's own site first.

name: Whitestone Pro Shop
location_or_platform: Flushing, Queens, New York (inside Whitestone Lanes)
why_a_fit: Calls itself an IBPSIA-certified, full-service pro shop doing fitting, drilling, plugging and repairs, in the largest metro market on the list.
audience_size_or_notes: The center was slated for redevelopment in 2023 reporting, and a 2025 report said it was still open. Confirm it is operating before spending time. Wave 3.
contact_path: Call the center desk and ask for the pro shop.

name: Bowling.com
type: online bowling retailer and pro shop
location_or_platform: Nacogdoches, Texas; ships from US warehouses
why_a_fit: Sells online since 1999, offers custom drilling by its pro staff, and runs a Knowledge Hub of tips and guides that bowlers read before buying. It carries wrist aids in the $40 to $100 band that the business plan uses as a price anchor, so a buyer already has a shelf for release aids.
audience_size_or_notes: Its About page lists a customer-service email and a toll-free line (not copied here). Hub articles are a content-partner route as well as a retail route. Pitch structure is in 04. Wave 3, after the Fit Kit has sales and the Study 1 table is public.
contact_path: Customer-service contact listed on the About page; ask for the category manager for training aids. Separate note to the Knowledge Hub editors.

name: BowlingBall.com
type: online bowling ball and bag retailer
why_a_fit: A large online bowling retailer in a review-directory listing for the category, selling balls, bags and related gear. Another retailer on the list gives a second buyer to compare terms with.
audience_size_or_notes: One low-quality result ties this site to a Connecticut business called Buddies Pro Shop; treat that link as unverified. Review-directory entries are retailer-supplied. Confirm ownership and contacts on the official site first. Wave 3.
contact_path: Contact form on the official store site, once ownership is confirmed.

name: DiscountBowlingSupply.com
why_a_fit: A mid-size online retailer in the same directory that carries balls, bags, shoes and accessories. A smaller buyer pool can make a 90-day pilot (see 04) easier to agree.
audience_size_or_notes: Retailer-supplied directory listing only. Confirm company details on the official site. Wave 3.
contact_path: Contact form on the official store site.

name: Etsy
why_a_fit: Planned discovery channel in the business plan, linking out to the configurator because the listing's single free-text box cannot hold a ten-field drill sheet. Fee numbers seen: $0.20 listing, 6.5% transaction, 3% plus $0.25 processing, 12% to 15% on offsite-ad sales.
audience_size_or_notes: No dedicated Etsy shop for bowling trainers turned up in our search, which supports the gap finding. Fee figures come from a third-party guide; confirm on Etsy's own fee page. Listing copy is in 04 Section F. Wave 3.
contact_path: Open a seller account and publish the listing from 04 Section F; no outreach needed.

name: eBay
why_a_fit: Roller rev trainers and release trainers already sell here at about $41 to $48 plus shipping, so buyers search for this category. A listing with the drill-sheet angle would sit beside them.
audience_size_or_notes: Prices seen were on eBay's German site for US sellers and vary by listing. eBay is a place to see demand, not our first selling channel, because the drill sheet cannot be captured in a listing. Wave 4.
contact_path: Seller account; no outreach needed.

name: Amazon
why_a_fit: Wrist aids from the $40 to $100 band are listed here, and an Amazon listing is drafted in 04 Section E. Category gating and how to collect a fit sheet on Amazon are covered there.
audience_size_or_notes: A product-guide page shows Amazon prices of about $52 to $55 for wrist supports; guide is affiliate-supported, so treat as rough. Wave 3.
contact_path: Seller Central account and brand registration; check category approval in the seller dashboard.

name: Walmart Marketplace
why_a_fit: A bowling retailer already sells accessories here as a third-party seller (a tape insert tool), which shows the category is open to specialist sellers.
audience_size_or_notes: Low priority. Marketplace review rules apply: seeded units and affiliates stay out of the review pool. Wave 4.
contact_path: Seller application on the marketplace; no outreach needed.

name: MakerWorld
why_a_fit: A home for the Digital files tier ($29 puck, $39 pair) for bowlers who own printers. Bowling models seen here are tabletop games, so no grip trainer competes.
audience_size_or_notes: Digital files come from the configurator with the customer's own sheet, so a listing links to the configurator instead of selling a fixed file. Check platform rules on personalized files. Wave 4.
contact_path: Creator account; no outreach needed.

name: Thingiverse
why_a_fit: A printable switchable thumb slug for ball inserts is listed here (print-in-PETG notes from the author), which shows bowlers already print parts for fit.
audience_size_or_notes: That model has no thumb hole and needs fitting to the hand, so it covers a different need. Wave 4.
contact_path: Creator account; no outreach needed.

name: Brad and Kyle
type: instruction and PBA Tour vlog channel
location_or_platform: YouTube @bradandkylebowl; coaching and merch at their own site
why_a_fit: Two PBA Tour bowlers (Brad Miller and Kyle Sherman) whose videos include tutorials on hooking the ball, adding power and balance. Business plan lists them as a first-tier instruction channel.
audience_size_or_notes: About 229K subscribers per SocialCounts and SponsorRadar (mid-2026); older listings show 134K, so confirm on YouTube. SponsorRadar lists about 8 brand sponsors. Seed under tier A in 05; sponsored placement would need the paid-partnership disclosure. Wave 2.
contact_path: YouTube business email in the About tab; their website lists coaching and merch pages.

name: The House Bowling
location_or_platform: YouTube; run by pro bowler Packy Hanrahan
why_a_fit: Mixes entertainment with instructional videos for league-level bowlers and has the most sponsor history of the channels we checked, so a paid route is established if we ever want one.
audience_size_or_notes: About 224K to 225K subscribers (Feedspot and SponsorRadar); an older listing shows 66K. SponsorRadar estimates $626 to $1.3K per sponsored video. Seeding criteria in 05 exclude entertainment channels in the first round, so hold. Wave 3.
contact_path: YouTube business email in the About tab.

name: InsideBowling
why_a_fit: Free coaching videos covering footwork, adjustments and the pivot step, from a team of coaches and tour veterans. League bowlers who want to work on their game watch this channel.
audience_size_or_notes: About 109K subscribers per SponsorRadar; an older IZEA listing shows 61.3K. Roster reported differently by two sources (Mike Shady, Mike Jasnau and Bryan O'Keefe in one; other names in another), so confirm the current hosts. Wave 2.
contact_path: YouTube business email in the About tab.

name: Tenpin Doctors (JR Raymond)
location_or_platform: YouTube; also on the BowlerX team
why_a_fit: Product reviews and education from a PBA competitor. Business plan lists him as the mid-size coach-creator who already reviews gear. Seeded tier B in 05.
audience_size_or_notes: About 81.6K subscribers per SponsorRadar. A BowlerX announcement says he reviews products across the market after dropping other brand ties. His BowlerX role means any approach must tell both sides about the other and carry its own disclosure. Wave 2.
contact_path: YouTube business email in the About tab; the retailer he works with can also route a message.

name: Darren Tang
why_a_fit: Won PBA titles with both one-handed and two-handed styles, so a puck for one hand and a spinner for the other are both relevant. Business plan names him a first-tier instruction channel.
audience_size_or_notes: IZEA lists 62.8K subscribers (older); the business plan quotes about 265K. Content mix per IZEA is equipment and challenges against his brother, so confirm recent uploads include instruction. Check his equipment-sponsor terms before sending a unit so nobody is put in a conflict. Wave 3.
contact_path: YouTube business email in the About tab.

name: Athletic Bowling
why_a_fit: Hook technique and slow-motion breakdowns of how pros release the ball. Slow-motion release analysis is the audience that wants a release drill.
audience_size_or_notes: Subscriber count not found. One search could not confirm the host's name, so verify who runs it before sending anything. Wave 1.
contact_path: YouTube business email in the About tab.

name: Revier's Coaching (Logan Revier)
type: USBC-certified coach with a free YouTube channel
why_a_fit: Founded September 2023. The coach describes experience with the traditional one-handed technique, a no-thumb one-handed method and the two-handed style, and publishes free videos. A small, hungry channel is the right size for a first seeded unit.
audience_size_or_notes: Subscriber count not found. Credentials and average claims come from his own site. Seed with the spinner and the puck so he can speak to both thumb-in and no-thumb students. Wave 1.
contact_path: Contact page on the coaching site; messages through the YouTube channel.

name: Prodigy Bowlers Tour (Randy Brown)
type: USBC Silver-trained coach and YouTube series host
why_a_fit: Hosts a youth bowling series that has carried short coaching tips since 2016 and gives one-on-one lessons from $75. Youth and parents are the audience for the Rev Spinner.
audience_size_or_notes: Subscriber count not found. A fundraising page for the series is older than his move to Kansas, so rely on the USBC coach profile for current facts. Wave 1.
contact_path: Contact route on the coach profile; messages through the YouTube channel.

name: Mark Baker (West Pac Training Center)
type: PBA coach with paid video series and free YouTube lessons
location_or_platform: Online video series, YouTube lessons and a training center
why_a_fit: Sells a paid video series with versions for one-handers, two-handers and seniors, publishes release lessons on YouTube, and appears as a guest coach in a paid league-bowler community. The one-hander and senior versions match our core customer.
audience_size_or_notes: Series prices came from a single review and may have changed ($75 each for two titles, the third included free). Any public quote waits until he has said something; use [QUOTE PLACEHOLDER — Mark Baker] until then. Wave 2.
contact_path: Contact page on his coaching site; the paid community he guest coaches in can also pass a message.

name: TV Bowling Supply (America's Pro Shop)
location_or_platform: YouTube; shops owned by PBA professionals Chris Via and Michael Tang
why_a_fit: A channel tied to working pro shops, with ball tests and match coverage. The owners handle drill sheets daily, so they can judge fit in seconds.
audience_size_or_notes: About 59.7K subscribers per SponsorRadar; 52.7K in an older listing. Content skews to tournaments and equipment tests, so it is a pro-shop conversation first and a creator conversation second. Wave 2.
contact_path: YouTube business email in the About tab.

name: Bowling Planet
why_a_fit: Similar-channel listing places it beside the product reviewers, with a comparable audience size.
audience_size_or_notes: About 57K subscribers per SponsorRadar; no sponsors detected there. Content type is unconfirmed, so watch recent uploads before reaching out. Wave 3.
contact_path: YouTube business email in the About tab.

name: Art of Bowling
why_a_fit: A channel described as breaking the game into simple fundamentals and drills. Drill-based teaching is the format our six drills fit.
audience_size_or_notes: Named on a ranking of bowling channels; subscriber count and upload rate not found. Check recent uploads before reaching out. Wave 1.
contact_path: YouTube business email in the About tab.

name: hihbowling
why_a_fit: Described as teaching the basics most bowlers skip. A basics audience asks about grip and hand position first.
audience_size_or_notes: Named on a ranking of bowling channels; subscriber count not found. Wave 1.
contact_path: YouTube business email in the About tab.

name: 220 Average Bowler
why_a_fit: Appears in channel roundups under a name that suggests a league-average bowler's view. That is the buyer's own point of view.
audience_size_or_notes: Only the name surfaced; content type and size unverified. Watch before contacting. Wave 3.
contact_path: YouTube business email in the About tab.

name: Youth Bowler Matthew
why_a_fit: Father and son channel that gives newer bowlers advice on equipment and targeting. Parents of young bowlers are the Rev Spinner buyer.
audience_size_or_notes: No subscriber count found. Any video that features a minor needs a parent's written consent on our side and a disclosure that fits the product. Wave 3.
contact_path: YouTube channel About tab; the parent runs the account.

name: Above 180.com Bowling Podcast
why_a_fit: Topics include coaching, finding a good pro shop and ball reviews, and one episode covers fit for league bowlers. Our story is about fit.
audience_size_or_notes: Episode counts and download numbers not found. Candidate for tier D in 05 (podcast host seeded unit). Wave 2.
contact_path: Contact link on the show page or podcast app listing; the show's own site.

name: Sweep The Rack Bowling Podcast
why_a_fit: Weekly show tagged for bowling leagues and equipment. Weekly cadence means a fast turn on a guest request.
audience_size_or_notes: Audience not found. Wave 2.
contact_path: Contact link on the show page or podcast app listing.

name: On The Gutter
why_a_fit: Brings on pros and industry guests, so a founder interview about fit could sit among equipment debates.
audience_size_or_notes: Audience not found. Wave 3.
contact_path: Contact link on the show page.

name: Ten Pin Life
why_a_fit: Describes covering the people, skills and equipment of the sport; archive back to 2022.
audience_size_or_notes: Audience not found. Wave 3.
contact_path: Contact link on the show page.

name: Professional House Bowlers
why_a_fit: Local, conversational show with episodes on equipment choices and adult league bowling.
audience_size_or_notes: Audience not found. Wave 3.
contact_path: Contact link on the show page.

name: Bowling With The Fef!
why_a_fit: Bowling stories from bowlers of every level; a founder story about printing a drill sheet suits the format.
audience_size_or_notes: Audience not found. Wave 3.
contact_path: Contact link on the show page.

name: Bowling This Month
location_or_platform: bowlingthismonth.com; owned by BTM Digital Media, LLC
why_a_fit: The site says a significant portion of its readers are coaches and pro shop operators, and it publishes the fit and release articles the business plan cites. A feature or a reader letter about fit reaches both groups.
audience_size_or_notes: Paid subscription (as low as $3.58 a month billed annually) and a free email newsletter. No contact address found in search. Offer a review unit printed from a writer's own sheet and ask the piece to say it was free. Wave 2.
contact_path: Contact route from the About page; ask for the editor.

name: Bowlers Journal International
why_a_fit: The only consumer-facing bowling magazine still printing, per its site. The 2024 media kit says 62% of readers do not work in the industry, so these are bowlers.
audience_size_or_notes: Readership numbers beyond that percentage not found. The USBC offers it to members through a partnership, so keep any copy free of implied USBC involvement. Paid ad path through the media kit. Wave 3.
contact_path: Advertising and editorial contacts via the magazine's information page and 2024 media kit.

name: 11thFrame.com
why_a_fit: Covers pro shops, coaching camps, tournaments and state associations in detail, including shop-level news. Good for a local-angle story once a pro shop signs.
audience_size_or_notes: Audience not found. Pitch after the first shop is live, so the story has a name and a location. Wave 2.
contact_path: News tip or contact route on the site; pitch the editor by email with a photo.

name: FloBowling
why_a_fit: Covers the PBA Tour, USBC championships and local leagues, and runs a public Facebook group for fans. One outlet reaches both press and community.
audience_size_or_notes: Group launched April 2020; no later membership data found. Wave 3.
contact_path: Contact route on the site; editors listed on articles.

name: BowlingLife
type: bowling media project with podcast and tutorials
location_or_platform: bowlinglife.eu; creator page on a sponsorship-booking site
why_a_fit: Publishes podcasts, tutorials and short-form videos for bowlers who want to get better. Its creator page suggests it takes sponsor requests.
audience_size_or_notes: Based in Europe per the domain, so US shipping and prices need to be stated. Audience not found. Wave 3.
contact_path: Booking form on its creator page.

name: Bowling Center Management
location_or_platform: Print and digital; official publication of the center owners association
why_a_fit: Reaches center managers and proprietors, who decide whether a pro shop carries a training aid and who run the shops FitSlice wants as drill-sheet capture points.
audience_size_or_notes: Circulation hidden behind a paywall on the media database. Wave 3.
contact_path: Press contact route listed in the media database entry; email submission for releases.

name: National Bowling Academy
why_a_fit: Instruction library with videos on thumb timing, release timing, grip pressure and fit. These are the same topics our six drills practice. Coaches on the site include USBC Silver and Gold level coaches.
audience_size_or_notes: Channel about 69K subscribers per SponsorRadar, with no detected sponsors. Most content sits behind a membership. Seed a unit to a coach on the site, then ask whether they want to show it. Wave 1.
contact_path: Contact route on the About page; message individual coaches through their author pages.

name: Kegel Training Center
type: bowling training center and coaching program
why_a_fit: Hires teaching professionals who give lessons, run camps and do fitting and drilling in the shop, and coach a college team. A single contact reaches coaches, fitters and a team.
audience_size_or_notes: Source is a 2023 job posting, so staffing may have changed. A coach there reached USBC Gold certification (2019 article). Wave 2.
contact_path: Contact route on the company site; ask for the training center director.

name: Peak Performance Bowling camps (Mike Shady)
location_or_platform: Wisconsin; small sessions of about six students
why_a_fit: One-day camps with swing analysis, a mental game and a take-home workbook. A camp handout is a good place for a drill sheet and a trainer demo.
audience_size_or_notes: Newest listing found is from 2020, so confirm the camps still run. Hall of Famer and national-team assistant coach per 11thFrame. Wave 2.
contact_path: Contact details appear in older camp listings only; confirm current route on his coaching site first.

name: USBC ITRC Pro Shop Clinic
type: training course for pro shop staff
location_or_platform: International Training and Research Center, Arlington, Texas
why_a_fit: A four-day clinic for pro shop technicians that ends in IBPSIA certification, with five students per instructor. It is where new technicians learn fitting and drilling.
audience_size_or_notes: Run by the governing body, so nothing we say or print may state or imply that the governing body backs FitSlice. Ask the instructor only for a conversation about whether technicians would find a sizer plate useful. Wave 3.
contact_path: Contact route listed on the clinic page.

name: IBPSIA
type: pro shop and instructors trade association
location_or_platform: Managed by the center owners association; headquartered in Arlington, Texas
why_a_fit: The trade body for the exact people the pro-shop program targets. Business plan cites its fit weighting: hole size about 20%, span and pitch 40% each.
audience_size_or_notes: No public directory of certified shops found; certification claims are self-reported by shops. Leadership details in our results are old. Pitch member communications only after a few shops are live, and never imply that the association backs FitSlice. Wave 3.
contact_path: Contact route through the center owners association site or the association's member communications.

name: USBC Coaching
location_or_platform: Online Level I; higher levels at the training center
why_a_fit: Level I certification is online, which is why many local coaches are certified and are reachable. The program is the source of tier C coaches in 05.
audience_size_or_notes: Never ask the program to back FitSlice, and never use its marks in outreach. Reach coaches one at a time through their own pages and the coach directory. Wave 3.
contact_path: Individual coach profiles in the coaching directory; no program-level outreach.

name: USBC Bowling Academy
why_a_fit: A video library with free and premium tiers featuring national team coaches and top pros. It shows where league bowlers already go for release instruction.
audience_size_or_notes: Launch coverage priced it at $4.99 for 30 days or $34.99 a year; current pricing unverified. Governing-body content, so watch only. Wave 4.
contact_path: No outreach planned.

name: BPAA Bowling Summit 2027
location_or_platform: Westin Fort Lauderdale Beach Resort, Florida; Jan 10 to 12, 2027
why_a_fit: The mid-winter conference for center proprietors, managers and industry leaders. Center owners decide on pro shop programs. It is the first event on the calendar and the cheapest to attend.
audience_size_or_notes: The 2026 exhibitor contract listed tabletop space at $999 or $1,199 including one table and two chairs; 2027 terms not seen. Third-party calendars list wrong cities, so use the BPAA page. Wave 1 for requesting the contract and deadline; book only after Study 1 has passed.
contact_path: Exhibitor contract and sales contact on the association's Summit page.

name: International Bowl Expo
location_or_platform: 2026 edition at Gaylord Opryland, Nashville (June 28 to July 3 per a listing); 2027 not found
why_a_fit: The trade show where pro shop operators and proprietors see new products, and where IBPSIA runs training and a tournament. The pro-shop program plan in 03 Section 9 is built for this show.
audience_size_or_notes: Booth from $1,995 for a 10 by 10 per an older page. The association's rules require suppliers that do not run a center or pro shop to buy a booth. Dates conflict across listings. Do not book until Study 1 has passed. Wave 3.
contact_path: Exhibitor sales contact on the association's Expo page.

name: USBC Open Championships 2027
location_or_platform: South Point Bowling Plaza, Las Vegas; more than 12,000 teams registered as of a September 2026 release; dates not found
why_a_fit: The one-handed, thumb-in customer in one building: the business plan cites more than 58,000 adult bowlers at the 2025 event and a field that skews male and 50 and over. Plan 06 Section 9 reserves a vendor application for this event.
audience_size_or_notes: No source seen in our searches confirms an exhibit area or how vendors apply. Confirm with the event team first. FitSlice may name the event only as a location. Nothing we print or say may imply the organizer backs FitSlice. Wave 3.
contact_path: Event contact route on the governing body's tournament page; ask about vendor and exhibitor policy.

name: USBC Women's Championships 2027
location_or_platform: New Victory Lanes, Mooresville, North Carolina; April 18 to July 25, 2027
why_a_fit: A 14-week event with more than 3,900 four-player teams registered at last report. Thumb-in women bowlers use the same product, and the Charlotte region is a first visit in 20 years.
audience_size_or_notes: Vendor area not confirmed. The tournament added two weeks of squads in July 2026, so volume is trending up. Wave 3.
contact_path: Event contact route on the governing body's tournament page; ask about vendors.

name: Junior Gold Championships 2027 and trade show
location_or_platform: Indianapolis area; July 10 to 17, 2027 (2026 trade show was in Minneapolis)
why_a_fit: A trade show described as free to attend and drawing more than 9,000 people, with merchandise, seminars and collegiate booths. A Rev Spinner event: youth, parents and coaches.
audience_size_or_notes: The 9,000 figure is a single unconfirmed source per the business plan. Dates for the 2026 trade show differed between listings. Parent-facing safety copy applies; spinner only for children under 12 with an adult present. Wave 3.
contact_path: Trade show and registration page on the governing body's youth site; vendor application listed there.

name: USBC Senior Championships
location_or_platform: 2026 edition Aug 4 to 7 at Ashwaubenon Bowling Alley, Green Bay; 2027 host not found
why_a_fit: Bowlers 50 and over, the thumb-in generation. A smaller event than the Open, so a table is cheap to try.
audience_size_or_notes: No source seen confirms a vendor area. Host for 2027 was not announced in our results. Wave 3.
contact_path: Event page on the governing body's site; ask about vendors.

name: PBA Bowlerstore.com Central Classic
location_or_platform: Pla-Mor Lanes, Coldwater, Ohio; Aug 14 to 16 in 2026 (18th annual)
why_a_fit: A small town event that draws a crowd and is title-sponsored by an online pro shop retailer. Local coverage says it has run since 2007 and grows each year, so a table beside the sponsor's own audience is a warm start.
audience_size_or_notes: No vendor area confirmed. Coverage mentions a meet-and-greet with pros. Regional events are where the demo script gets rehearsed, per 06 Section 9. Wave 2 (rehearsal event).
contact_path: Event contact route on the PBA regional page; ask the center owner about vendors.

name: PBA50 Tour regional events
location_or_platform: Multiple US stops, April to August (2026 examples: Villages, Florida; Greeley, Colorado; Whitehall, Pennsylvania)
why_a_fit: Senior professionals and their fans: bowlers over 50, many thumb-in. Regional stops count only toward regional points and are small and frequent.
audience_size_or_notes: Vendor areas not confirmed for any stop. 2027 schedule not seen. Wave 3.
contact_path: Tournament pages on the tour site; ask the host center about vendors.

name: r/Bowling
why_a_fit: The largest bowling subreddit; common topics include ball choice, form and release. Business plan calls for a drill-sheet post and a 300-response poll here.
audience_size_or_notes: 111K members per GummySearch (updated June 2026); 57K per another guide. Ask the moderators for permission before any post (06 Section 4). Founder answers questions for 48 hours. Wave 1.
contact_path: Modmail to the moderators; post only with their permission.

name: r/BowlingLife
why_a_fit: A small subreddit for news, tips and questions from bowling fans.
audience_size_or_notes: 344 members in a January 2025 snapshot. Not worth a post of its own; mention it only if its moderators ask. Wave 4.
contact_path: Modmail to the moderators.

name: FloBowling Fans
why_a_fit: Public group for fans of the PBA Tour, championships and local leagues, run by the FloBowling team.
audience_size_or_notes: Launched April 2020; current size and activity unknown. Group rules decide whether links are allowed (06 Section 5). Wave 2.
contact_path: Join the group and read the rules; post only if links and maker posts are allowed.

name: Bowling Talk
why_a_fit: A paid community for league bowlers with live coaching calls and guest sessions, including the coach named in the creator list. Members want to practice consistency.
audience_size_or_notes: 1.1K members and about $7 a month per its page; page also shows a $10 tier. Figures come from the community's own marketing page. Offer the owner a seeded unit and a guest drill demo, with disclosure. Wave 1.
contact_path: Message the community owner through the Skool page.

name: BowlersNetwork
why_a_fit: A social network for amateur players, professionals, fans, coaches and bowling centers, with a feed for scores, photos and videos.
audience_size_or_notes: Version 1.0.2 released June 2026; no user numbers found. Developer-controlled listing only. Wave 4.
contact_path: Contact route on the app store listing.

name: LaneTalk
why_a_fit: A scoring app where bowlers follow friends and comment on games, a place where league bowlers already gather.
audience_size_or_notes: User numbers not found. Wave 4.
contact_path: Contact route on the app's site.

name: BowlingCommunity.com forums
why_a_fit: Describes amateur and professional forums with advice on lane conditions and choosing a ball.
audience_size_or_notes: The self-description we found dates from 2006, so activity is unknown. Check before spending time. Wave 4.
contact_path: Register on the forum and read the rules.

name: Bon's Bowling Area
why_a_fit: General bowling fan server where beginners and experienced players swap tips.
audience_size_or_notes: Size and activity unknown. Wave 4.
contact_path: Join through the server listing and read the rules.
